inference: Weak proxy only: the two older active offers are consistent with sustained advertiser interest, but do not establish consumer demand or profitable performance.
competition_signal.justification: Usable first-page evidence shows limited eligible competition, but the second-page failure leaves the planned sample incomplete. Confidence is low; no failed-page records were counted.
competition_signal.operational_definition: Qualitative competition within this exact-query AU sample: currently active ads with actual start dates on/before 2026-08-04, passing supplied exclusions and scope. Scale: -1 unknown, 0 none observed in an assessable sample, 1-3 limited, 4-6 meaningful diverse presence, 7-10 substantial diverse presence. Advertiser diversity matters more than repeated ads from one page. This is not a calibrated market or demand measure.

error: The second search page failed after one usable page. The report covers only the first page; no retry was made.
